name: Maid-san to Boin Damashii
original_name: メイドさんとボイン魂
source: A rich protagonist that loves maids and sex. Always on the look out for new maids. A chance encounter with old childhood friend seeking employment comes at perfect time as his head maid is setting up for retirement soon. He is now looking for a new head maid and will have to spend time with each maid personally, all who have unique personalities and backgrounds.
translation: 主角是个喜欢女仆与性爱的富家子弟，始终在寻找新的女仆。就在他的首席女仆即将退休之际，他偶然遇见了正在求职的儿时好友，时机恰到好处。如今，他要寻找新的首席女仆，并亲自与每一位女仆相处；她们都有着独特的性格与背景。
